name: OpenSearch — Log Observability with YugabyteDB
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-opensearch.sh && echo "" && echo ">> Terminal > Run Task > opensearch-demo   (guided YB observability demo)" && echo ">> Terminal > Run Task > opensearch-ws     (Workshop shell for manual exercises)"'

tasks.label: opensearch-demo
tasks.detail: YugabyteDB logs + metrics shipped via OTel into OpenSearch — observability demo (init-opensearch/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: cd init-opensearch && echo '🔭 opensearch-demo  —  OpenSearch + YugabyteDB Observability' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: opensearch-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for OpenSearch + YugabyteDB manual exercises (init-opensearch/)
tasks.command: bash .devcontainer/scripts/wait-for-svc.sh 'http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health' 'OpenSearch :9200' 'http://localhost:5601/api/status' 'OpenSearch Dashboards :5601' && cd init-opensearch && echo '🔭 opensearch-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual curl / ysqlsh commands here' && exec bash
